name: rdModel_ComputeMeshLighting
comment: Rdcamera.c: picks the light level of a mesh from the current geometry/lighting/texture modes (gouraud, flat, per-vertex) and hands it to the mesh draw callback at +0x14

name: rdCamera_Init
proto: int rdCamera_Init(void * camera, float fov, int a, int b, int c, float zoom)
comment: Allocates the 0x34-byte projection block (camera+0x48), clamps the FOV to 5..179 and selects perspective projection

name: rdCamera_SetProjectType
comment: 0 orthographic, 1 perspective; installs the project/unproject function pointers (+0x4c/+0x50) and rebuilds the frustum

name: rdCamera_BuildFOV
comment: Computes the projection scale from FOV and canvas size and the frustum planes
